title: Fairness Certification for Natural Language Processing and Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Development of a comprehensive fairness certification framework through qualitative, semi-structured expert interviews. The paper proposes auditing methodologies including data representativeness checks, functional testing, robustness invariance testing, adversarial testing, and continuous model monitoring.

Proposed for evaluation within the framework using methods such as assessing the similarity of embeddings in semantic vector space and conducting robustness invariance testing (e.g., counterfactual prompt replacements).
Proposed for evaluation via data quality assessments, specifically utilizing demographic distribution checks and frequency-based screening to identify and mitigate underrepresentation.
Proposed for evaluation by assessing regional and societal dependencies in model outcomes, ensuring models are tested against diverse cultural contexts and regional fairness perceptions.
